title: Principal Engineer Software (Full Stack)
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
**Job Summary**
 Prisma Access™ (formally GlobalProtect Cloud Service) provides protection straight from the cloud to make access to the cloud secure. It combines the connectivity and security you need and delivers it everywhere you need it. Using cutting\-edge public and private cloud technologies extending the next\-generation security protection to all cloud services, customers on\-premise remote networks and mobile users.
   

  

 As a Principal Full Stack Engineer on the Prisma Access team, you will be instrumental in developing our next\-generation security offerings. You will focus on creating advanced visualization, monitoring, configuration, and analytics solutions. This role involves designing and implementing new UI web services, managing complex backend deployments, and handling integrations with both public and private cloud environments to protect our digital way of life.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement scalable, modular full\-stack architectures, ensuring seamless data flow between high\-performance frontend interfaces and robust backend microservices.
* Actively participate in the full product development lifecycle, from API contract definition and schema design to implementation, automated testing, and CI/CD deployment.
* Develop and maintain high\-concurrency UI web services and RESTful/gRPC APIs that integrate with public (AWS, GCP) and private cloud infrastructures.
* Optimize data fetching, caching, and state management strategies to handle massive security datasets from distributed systems like BigQuery or Snowflake.
* Proactively collaborate with design, product, and platform engineering teams to ensure frontend requirements are supported by backend capabilities.
* Continuously identify, suggest, and implement improvements to development processes, including containerization (Docker/K8s) and server\-side performance tuning.


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related equivalent field.
* Minimum of 10 years of professional programming experience with a demonstrated track record of building complex, data\-driven web applications.
* Expert\-level proficiency with ReactJS and modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems in high\-scale production environments.
* Strong professional experience in at least one backend language such as GoLang, Python, or Java, with a deep understanding of asynchronous programming and concurrency.
* Proven experience designing and building scalable microservices and modular architectures for complex systems.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-native technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes (K8s), and cloud provider services (e.g., AWS Lambda, S3, or DynamoDB).
* Proven ability to lead technical initiatives and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams in a dynamic, fast\-paced setting.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, as well as distributed data processing (e.g, Redis).
* Deep knowledge of API design principles (REST, GraphQL, or gRPC) and experience with authentication protocols (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML).
* AI first approach to coding and problem solving. Experience with AI based coding tools such as Claude code, codex, cursor, co\-pilot (GitHub).
* Experience working within the cybersecurity industry or on security\-focused products (e.g., SASE, SSE, or Firewall management).


**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Staff Software Engineer – Full Stack | Node.js, TypeScript, React | Multi-Tenant B2B SaaS
description:
📍
 **Remote – India** 




**💰 ₹25–50 LPA total CTC, depending on experience and scope** 




**🕒 Full\-time** 




  





**Staff Engineer \| Node.js \| TypeScript \| React \| Multi\-Tenant SaaS \| Software Architecture \| Technical Leadership**



 Shape the architecture. Control the quality. Stay hands\-on.
 
 Script Assist is looking for a hands\-on
 **Staff Software Engineer** 
 with deep production experience in
 **Node.js, TypeScript and React** 
 to help shape the architecture and technical direction of a complex multi\-tenant healthcare SaaS platform.
 



 We are looking for someone who has already worked on a substantial
 **enterprise B2B SaaS product** 
 and understands what happens as that product becomes large:
 


* More modules
* More integrations
* More customer configuration
* More workflow variation
* More roles and permissions
* More historical data
* More dependencies
* More engineers
* More opportunities for seemingly small changes to have unexpected consequences



 You may currently be a:
 


* Staff Software Engineer
* Staff Engineer
* Staff Full Stack Engineer
* Lead Software Engineer
* Principal\-level IC
* Senior Technical Lead
* Experienced Senior Software Engineer already operating beyond your formal title



 This is
 **not** 
 an Engineering Manager position.
 



 It is also not an architect role where you stop working in production code.
 



 You will remain technically hands\-on while influencing the quality and direction of engineering well beyond your own implementation work.
   




 About Script Assist
 
 Script Assist is a UK healthcare technology company providing the technology and operating infrastructure behind complex private clinical and pharmacy services.
 



 Our platform connects clinics, pharmacies, prescribers, patients and operational teams.
 



 It supports substantial functionality across:
 


* Clinical workflows
* Prescribing
* Medication management
* Pharmacy workflows
* Inventory
* Dispensing
* Payments
* Subscriptions
* Fulfilment
* Communications
* Reporting
* Permissions
* Customer configuration
* Third\-party integrations



 The difficult engineering problem is not any one of these features.
 



 It is
 **how they interact** 
 .
 



 A workflow may behave differently depending on:
 


* Customer
* Clinical service
* User role
* Pharmacy
* Medication
* Configuration
* Integration
* Payment status
* Previous actions
* Operational exceptions



 The product therefore needs engineers who can understand local implementation details while simultaneously protecting the coherence of the wider platform.
   




 🧭 Your role
 
 You will take deep technical ownership of a substantial part of Script Assist while helping establish engineering patterns that scale beyond it.
 



 You will move comfortably between:
 


* Architecture
* Product behaviour
* Node.js services
* React applications
* Databases
* Integrations
* Code review
* Production incidents
* Mentoring
* Technical strategy



 You should be able to understand the hardest parts of the codebase without becoming the only person capable of changing them.
   




 Architecture and system design
 
 You will:
 


* Define domain and module boundaries
* Design backend services and APIs
* Define data ownership
* Review database models
* Design integration patterns
* Establish appropriate shared abstractions
* Improve configuration architecture
* Challenge unnecessary coupling
* Reduce fragile customer\-specific behaviour
* Lead important technical migrations
* Help simplify accumulated complexity



 You should understand when to introduce:
 


* Configuration
* Shared services
* Events
* Queues
* Transactions
* APIs
* Feature flags
* Migration layers



 and equally importantly, when
 **not** 
 to introduce them.
   




 Hands\-on engineering
 
 You will remain capable of personally implementing difficult production changes.
 



 That includes:
 


* **Node.js / TypeScript backend development**
* **React / TypeScript frontend development**
* **API design**
* **Database work**
* **Integration development**
* **Debugging**
* **Performance investigation**
* **Refactoring**
* **Testing**
* **Production incident investigation**



 You should still enjoy working directly with code.
   




 Multi\-tenant SaaS complexity
 
 The strongest candidates will have experience with products where many customers share the same platform while behaving differently.
 



 Relevant problems include:
 


 Tenant architecture
 * Tenant isolation
* Tenant\-aware data models
* Customer\-specific configuration
* Organisations and sub\-organisations
* Entitlements
* Feature flags


 Workflow complexity
 * Workflow engines
* State machines
* Rules engines
* Configurable business logic
* Approval flows
* Long\-running workflows
* Versioned workflows
* Exception handling


 Permissions
 * RBAC
* User roles
* Organisation\-level access
* Fine\-grained permissions
* Auditability


 Integrations
 * REST APIs
* GraphQL
* Webhooks
* Public APIs
* External systems
* Background jobs
* Asynchronous processing
* Event\-driven architecture


 Distributed\-system behaviour
 * Idempotency
* Retries
* Partial failures
* Transactions
* Outbox patterns
* Queues
* Dead\-letter handling
* Concurrency
* Reconciliation
* Correlation IDs


 Product evolution
 * Schema changes
* Data migrations
* Backward compatibility
* Safe rollouts
* Feature flags
* Progressive migrations
* Production monitoring
* Incident recovery



 You do not need to have implemented every specific pattern.
 



 We care about whether you have
 **actually solved these kinds of problems** 
 .
   




 Technical leadership
 
 A Staff Engineer at Script Assist should improve the work of other engineers.
 



 You will:
 


* Lead important design reviews
* Review difficult code
* Challenge poor technical decisions
* Establish engineering patterns
* Mentor Senior and mid\-level engineers
* Help engineers decompose complex problems
* Document major technical decisions
* Improve testing strategy
* Improve observability
* Help identify technical debt worth solving
* Resolve architectural disagreements
* Work with Product on technical trade\-offs
* Raise the quality of engineering across your area



 We do not want someone who responds to every difficult problem by saying:
 


 “I'll just build it myself.”
 
 You should be capable of solving the hardest problems while making the people around you increasingly capable of solving them too.
   




 Production ownership
 
 You will take responsibility beyond merge and deployment.
 



 You should care about:
 


* What happened in production
* Whether customers are seeing unexpected behaviour
* Performance
* Errors
* Failed integrations
* Operational recovery
* Logging
* Monitoring
* Reconciliation
* Incident prevention



 A major production incident should result not merely in a patch, but in a better system afterwards.
   




 Essential technical background
 
 We need substantial recent production experience with:
 


* **Node.js**
* **TypeScript**
* **React / React.js**
* **Backend systems**
* **API design**
* **Databases**
* **Distributed applications**
* **Automated testing**
* **Git**
* **Docker**
* **CI/CD**
* **Cloud environments**
* **Production observability**



 Particularly relevant:
 


* NestJS
* Express
* Fastify
* PostgreSQL
* MongoDB
* Redis
* GraphQL
* Kafka
* RabbitMQ
* SQS
* Kubernetes
* AWS / Azure / GCP
* Integration testing
* Event\-driven systems



 One particular database, message broker or cloud provider is
 **not** 
 mandatory.
 


 Node.js requirement
 
 We need genuine
 **backend Node.js ownership** 
 .
 



 Experience limited to:
 


* Front\-end build tooling
* Server\-side rendering
* Simple proxy services
* Thin BFF layers



 is insufficient unless you also have substantial Node.js backend experience elsewhere.
   




 Relevant product backgrounds
 
 The most interesting candidates will often come from mature enterprise SaaS products involving:
 


* Workflow management
* Automation
* CRM
* Identity
* Permissions
* Governance
* APIs
* Developer platforms
* Operational systems
* Enterprise configuration



 Potentially relevant engineering environments include:
 


* Okta / Auth0
* Blue Yonder / JDA Software
* Freshworks
* Diligent
* Postman
* LeadSquared
* Comparable enterprise SaaS businesses



 These are examples only.
 



 We assess
 **your actual product ownership** 
 , not your employer's brand.
   




 How you should think
 
 We are interested in engineers who ask questions such as:
 


* What is the real domain boundary here?
* Is this customer\-specific or product behaviour?
* Should this become configuration?
* What happens to existing tenants?
* What happens to workflows already underway?
* What happens if the event arrives twice?
* How do we recover from partial failure?
* How do we prove this migration is safe?
* How will another engineer understand this in two years?
* How do we make this simpler rather than merely making it work?



 That style of reasoning matters enormously.
   




 Communication and judgement
 
 You will work directly with senior Product and Engineering colleagues across the UK and India.
 



 You should be able to:
 


* Explain difficult technical concepts clearly
* Challenge assumptions constructively
* Defend technical decisions with evidence
* Understand commercial/product constraints
* Avoid overengineering
* Make pragmatic trade\-offs
* Communicate clearly in written English
* Mentor without patronising or micromanaging


 Experience
 
 We expect strong candidates will typically have approximately
 **8–14\+ years of software engineering experience** 
 .
 



 However, Staff\-level scope matters more than calendar years.
 



 You do not necessarily need to hold a Staff title today.
 



 A Lead or exceptional Senior engineer who is already:
 


* Leading architecture
* Influencing several engineers
* Reviewing critical work
* Owning production behaviour
* Taking responsibility beyond individual features



 can absolutely be relevant.
   




 📈 Why join Script Assist?
 
 At a very large organisation, a Staff Engineer may own one layer or one subsystem of a much bigger machine.
 



 At Script Assist, you can have meaningful influence across a significant part of the product.
 



 You will help determine:
 


* How major areas are designed
* How the platform handles customer variation
* How engineers structure new functionality
* How code quality is maintained
* How technical debt is reduced
* How production issues are prevented
* How engineering scales as the company grows



 You will remain hands\-on.
 



 But the objective is not simply to become the person who can write the most difficult code.
 


* The objective is to make a substantial part of the platform — and the engineers responsible for it —
 **better because of your technical leadership** 
 .

title: Fullstack Developer Lead - Ads Solutions - App Dev and Maintenance
description:
**Join Us!**
 At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
   

  

 As the Fullstack developer Lead in the Google Operations Center, you'll lead a talented team of front\-end and full\-stack developers responsible for building and maintaining the critical tools and applications that power Google's internal operations. You'll play a key role in setting technical direction, fostering collaboration, and mentoring engineers, while ensuring the delivery of high\-quality solutions that meet the evolving needs of our users. If you're a strong leader with a passion for developing people and a deep understanding of software development best practices, we encourage you to apply!
   

  

**Position Responsibilities**
* Guide and mentor the team: Provide technical leadership, code reviews, and mentorship to both frontend and full\-stack developers, fostering their growth and ensuring code quality.
* Drive project delivery: Oversee project planning, execution, and delivery, ensuring projects stay on track, meet deadlines, and adhere to quality standards. Collaborate effectively: Work closely with product managers, stakeholders, and other teams to define project scope, gather requirements, and ensure successful project outcomes.
* Champion technical excellence: Promote best practices in software development, architecture, and coding, staying current with industry trends and ensuring the team's technical skills remain sharp.
* Build a high\-performing team: Cultivate a collaborative and supportive team environment, where individuals feel valued, motivated, and empowered to contribute their best work.


**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications:**
* 10y\+ solid experience as a Full Stack Developer with minimum 5\+ years of people management experience
* Expert with front\-end web development programming in Javascript, HTML5, CSS3 or TypeScript \& framework such as Angular.
* Expert with building web applications based on at least one of these technologies: Object\-Oriented Programming language such as JAVA or Python with hands on experience on REST \& SOAP APIs
* Strong hands on with Databases (SQL and NoSQL) and tuning queries for performance.
